FlowerPainter.Beach.Name: Beach
FlowerPainter.Recipe.Beach.Description: Real sand painted into the terrain from the water's edge, blending into the grass behind; umbrellas in loose rows, lifeguard posts, a promenade with short accesses onto landings, dunes behind.
FlowerPainter.Beach.style.Tooltip: Sandy, rocky (dirt texture with sand pockets), river, cove (wild dunes) or volleyball beach. Each lays out the shore differently.
FlowerPainter.Beach.waterSide.Tooltip: Which side of the area faces the water. Automatic finds the water; otherwise pick a side (north = +Z on the map).
FlowerPainter.Beach.beachDepth.Tooltip: How far the sand reaches inland from the waterline to the back path.
FlowerPainter.Beach.umbrellas.Tooltip: Umbrella sets (an umbrella with loungers) per hectare of sand.
FlowerPainter.Beach.layout.Tooltip: Loose groups like a public beach, or tidy rows like a resort lido.
FlowerPainter.Beach.carve.Tooltip: Grade the ground into one smooth gentle slope down to the waterline and on under the water (permanent): it lowers the ground and only fills small hollows; cliffs are left natural.
FlowerPainter.Beach.slope.Tooltip: Gradient of the carved beach. Real sand beaches are 2–8 %.
FlowerPainter.Beach.wetBand.Tooltip: Strip along the water kept free of umbrellas (boats, rocks and tide pools go here).
FlowerPainter.Beach.sandSurface.Tooltip: Also lay a sand surface over the beach (hard edged). Off by default: the sand is painted into the terrain instead. Useful on custom maps whose terrain layer 4 is not sand.
FlowerPainter.Beach.sandBlend.Tooltip: How far the sand texture fades into the ground behind the beach. Small = a crisp edge at the promenade, large = sand drifting far inland.
FlowerPainter.Beach.sandReach.Tooltip: Carry the sand and the graded slope past the outline down to the real water and on under it (see Sand under water), so the beach meets the water even when the area was drawn short of it (permanent).
FlowerPainter.Beach.paint.Tooltip: Paint the beach into the terrain texture like the game's Paint texture tool, with a soft blend (permanent).
FlowerPainter.Beach.paintLayer.Tooltip: Which terrain texture to paint: 1 dry grass, 2 lush grass, 3 dirt, 4 sand (on vanilla maps; custom maps may differ).
FlowerPainter.Beach.backdrop.Tooltip: What lies behind the back path: dunes with marram grass, a lawn, woods, or nothing.
FlowerPainter.Beach.duneDepth.Tooltip: How deep the dune belt (or the planted strip) is behind the back path.
FlowerPainter.Beach.duneFence.Tooltip: Short fence runs along the dune foot where the ground is even, with gaps where paths cross. Off by default: vanilla has no timber sand fence.
FlowerPainter.Beach.grassDensity.Tooltip: How much grass and scrub grows on the dunes or along the backdrop edge.
FlowerPainter.Beach.backPath.Tooltip: A path behind the sand, parallel to the water, with benches, lamps, huts and kiosks.
FlowerPainter.Beach.accessSpacing.Toolti: Distance between the short accesses from the promenade down onto the sand.
FlowerPainter.Beach.benchSpacing.Tooltip: Benches facing the sea along the back path. 0 = none.
FlowerPainter.Beach.landings.Tooltip: A small deck or paved landing at the end of each beach access, where the path meets the sand.
FlowerPainter.Beach.huts.Tooltip: Small groups of changing huts, or a long row of beach huts behind the back path.
FlowerPainter.Beach.lifeguards.Tooltip: Lifeguard posts behind the wet sand, facing the water (a tall chair, lifebuoy and flag unless you pick a lifeguard tower asset).
FlowerPainter.Beach.courts.Tooltip: Volleyball courts on the sand, parallel to the water. The volleyball beach adds some automatically.
FlowerPainter.Beach.jetties.Tooltip: Timber jetties from the sand out over the water, in line with an access path. They may reach past the outline over the water.
FlowerPainter.Beach.jettyLength.Tooltip: How far each jetty reaches out from the sand (it stops where the water ends).
FlowerPainter.Beach.jettyHead.Tooltip: A cross deck at the end of each jetty to swim from.
FlowerPainter.Beach.boats.Tooltip: Rowing boats and kayaks pulled up on the wet sand.
FlowerPainter.Beach.fires.Tooltip: Fire pits with seats around them on the sand.
FlowerPainter.Beach.rockClusters.Tooltip: Groups of rocks; on a rocky beach they straddle the waterline, in a cove they also form headlands.
FlowerPainter.Beach.tidePools.Tooltip: Shallow hollows near the waterline ringed by rocks (permanent terrain change).
FlowerPainter.Beach.Issue.NoCourtSpace: The beach is too shallow for volleyball courts.
FlowerPainter.Beach.Issue.FewerCourts: Only {0} of {1} volleyball courts fit on the sand.
FlowerPainter.Shore.Issue.NoWater: No water found next to the area: it faces away from the road (or the longest edge). Set Water side to choose.
FlowerPainter.Shore.Issue.WaterInside: Much of the area is water: only the dry part is built on.
FlowerPainter.AddOn.BeachBar.Name: Beach bar
FlowerPainter.AddOn.BeachBar.tables.Tool: Cafe tables on the terrace in front of each bar.
FlowerPainter.Shore.Issue.Cliff: {0}% of this shore is cliff: the cliff face is left natural, with a cliff-top walk and lookouts there instead.
FlowerPainter.Shore.Issue.Earthwork: The ground was only reshaped within limits (cut up to {0} m, fill up to {1} m): the design follows the terrain where it would have needed more.
FlowerPainter.Beach.underwater.Tooltip: How far the sand and the gentle beach slope continue under the water past the waterline (permanent).
